title: pvAddFieldArrays
body:
## pvAddFieldArrays

Deprecated name (since ParaView 5.13, removal planned for 5.14) of pvFieldArraysFromFile, with the same behaviour: the input passes through and the field-data arrays of a legacy VTK file (.vtk) are attached to it, to every block of a composite input. Use pvFieldArraysFromFile in new documents.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Documents using this id will need updating when ParaView removes the alias.
- Only field data is added, never point or cell arrays.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `AddFieldArrays`. Identity: `filters/AddFieldArrays`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":[],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file to read to get arrays Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |

onVisit commands:

```json
{
  "Reload": {
    "command": "Modified",
    "native": "Reload"
  }
}
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvAddFieldArrays",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  },
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
Example command request (pipeline node only): `"onVisit":["Reload"]`. Commands run in this authored order before the update.
